games.name: 📉 Cart ride to save canny cat [PONZI SCHEMES!]
games.desc:
a remake for crtscc is in the works, stay tuned

Core mechanics inspired by "Cart ride around a 75kw diesel generator". it should be in similar experiences go check it out too

The evil 🐈‍⬛ uncanny cats have kidnapped 🐈 canny cat and put him at the end of a perilous cart ride. Grab a cart and go save your kitty!

Controls/Tips:

CTRL to shiftlock
LMB or DOUBLE TAP to pick up unanchored part (such as a cart)
SHIFT + WASDQE or ROTATE BUTTON + JOYSTICK to rotate currently held part

To start the game, pick up a cart and place it on the rails, then click the green button to start the cart. Make sure to look out for traps along the way! 
Remember that if your cart derails, you can jump out and drag it back into place. 

Building and electrical signals in this game can be confusing at first. Just remember that only parts which are glued together will transfer signals, and don't be afraid to ask experienced players for help. 

Have fun! 💥💥💥

games.name: The Long Drive
games.desc:
📄The Long Drive is an adventure racing simulator with an apocalyptic theme and elements of survival in the harsh conditions of the surrounding world.

📄E - Interaction.
📄Shift - Run.
📄F - Use headlights.
📄R - Reload.
📄Backspace - Throw away an item.
📄V - Release the mouse.
📄Q - Turn on the music.
📄H - Honk.
📄X - Turn signals.

💎The peculiarity of the game is that the world can change completely randomly, which will not allow you to anticipate or avoid a dangerous situation.

✅Avoid the Svintusov and get to Almaty with loot boxes!

📊You should always be prepared for unexpected turns of events, strive to develop the main character, and also not forget about the main means of transportation.

📝Many features were taken from the original The Long Drive game, but we tried to change most of the mechanics.

games.name: Flood Escape: Classic
games.desc:
Locked in a flooding facility, you and your team must work together to push buttons, find the way out, crack the code and escape before the flood takes you!

Flood Escape Classic started development in September 2011, and is what kickstarted the Flood Escape series.

FEC persisted through many of Roblox's fundamental changes; Mobile Support, Dynamic Lighting, Filtering Enabled and many more.

While the game doesn't get updated often now due to focus on FE2, FEC's continued community and player count shows that the game continues to offer a solid experience for obby enthusiasts.

Flood Escape © Crazyblox Games 2011 - 2024

💪 To help you survive, join the game's group to get 10% more health. For even more benefits, consider becoming a premium member. As a premium member, you'll receive buffs such as more health and a higher jump, giving you an edge in your fight against the forest's fearsome monsters.
